decision: Individually exclude POD-EDIT-091 as Census data/navigation utility; preserve public route/data/search and separate Jagatsinghpur, Bada Osha, banking and other authored material. No local destination or related-discovery narrative is configured on this route.
scope_release: On separately reviewed merge after passing required checks; no website deployment because product unchanged.

anvesha.json.role: Anvesha separate AI source readiness; not human review

source.title: C-16: Population by mother tongue, Odisha — 2011

anvesha.json.rationale: The actual Jagatsinghapur route generates a leading-group sentence, district/residence statistics and tables from Census rows. It has no attached destination or reading-link narrative. Its value is data exploration and navigation to language profiles, not a sustained authored article. Recommend individual utility exclusion while retaining route, source labels and navigation.

search: Both spelling variants searched in voices and configured route contexts; exact Jagatsinghapur search provided no narrative lead.

preserve.scope: Authored Bada Osha account preserves Jagatsinghpur gazetteer p52 descriptions of steamed linga/snake-shaped offerings and calendar disagreement with Mahanti; neither universally reconciled nor evidence of district language.
Government district gazetteer bibliographic record, printed52; upload year not established publication year. Separate cultural source, not C16 support.
Dated banking snapshot with additional industrial research links; not household wealth or language evidence.

limits: Original saved workbook parsed directly, no redundant external research.
No current population, fluency, caste, ancestry or migration claims; groups and member rows not additive.
Statewide C17 cannot be assigned to this district.
Bada Osha and banking source claims were inspected in existing KB only, not externally reverified.
No live rendering, publication or human/community review; absence is scoped to searched configured route and KB, not all possible research.
No canonical, Git or public mutations or programme credit.
next_actions: Coordinator may record individually justified utility exclusion after independent review, preserving route and language navigation.
Preserve separate ritual/food and banking narratives; any future district-language article requires independently sourced narrative evidence.

samanta.json.rationale: Actual district380 route contains generated Census stats, group/return tables, rural/urban breakdowns and data-selected language links with generic interpretation guidance. Individually checked destination and related-reading configurations are empty; no sustained authored local narrative appears. Separate district-related articles are outside this classification.

spelling.check_history: Initial exact-name assertion detected workbook trailing space; strip for comparison only, original workbook unchanged. No spelling correction or route rename.

source_checks.method: Original C district, E trimmed name, F code and H:P nine-value comparison; population derived by summing mutually exclusive parent-group rows only.
